title: Privacy Policy | Winning predict

Visitors of winningpredict.com it may interest you to know that the privacy of our visitors is the top priority to us and as such we don't gamble with it.

In this privacy policy we would love to share with you on how Winningpredict handles the data of our users found on this platform.

At Winningpredict we make it a responsibility to make sure that all our users data and information is safe and not easily affected by cyber fraud and we don't give out your details or information to a third party body.

In accordance with our privacy policy it may interest you to know that once you submit your data or information it will be handled in utmost care to make sure that your data or information is safe and not attacked by a fraudster.

At Winningpredict we are solely responsible for day to day updating of our privacy policy and once any changes are done or our privacy policy is updated you will always find the changes and update on this page. 

Information we collect from our users at Winningpredict

Anybody that want to sign up on Winningpredict you need to provide the following details to us which include:

  • Full Name
  • Email address
  • Password
  • Country

What we do with information we collect from users on Winningpredict

There are so many purposes why we collect data and information from our users. The main reason is to make use of the data and information in order to tailor our services according to your want. This is the more reason you need to accept our cookies when you visit our website in order to help us and serve you better. Beside the information above your data and information can also serve in the following:

  • Once you register and submit your details with us we will make use of your data and information to send you periodic match updates across all football leagues, and other betting tips that you can select and bet at your favourite bookmaker that offers the best odds.
  • By providing your data and information while signing up will enable us to create a well secured account type that can not be easily accessed or hacked by anyone.

Parental Guidance PG +18

Winningpredict is not dedicated to people under the age of 18 therefore parents need to control their children and monitor what they are doing. You can easily block them from having access to betting platforms from your computer. Any day we find a particular account that belongs to the person under the age of 18 years we will terminate such account with immediate effect.

Account Protection from Cyber Attack

For the purpose of making sure your account is safe and secure with Winningpredict we work with the following security which include administrative security, physical security, and technical security. Working with the following security is not a guarantee but our developer and our technical team are working hand in hand to make sure your account is well protected and secure.
